## 🚀 Summary (1-2 sentences)
Add OpenTelemetry span creation around Rust plugin entrypoints and propagate parent trace context from Python into the Rust plugin boundary. This also adds a shared Rust telemetry helper and updates the secrets baseline to ignore all `Cargo.lock` files.
